_comment: Film 79 Mirelo SFX 2.0 (mirelo-ai/sfx2.0/text-to-audio, 0.01 USD/s, 2 samples each, 2026-11-25). Used: relay_a (cut), phones_a, cars_a, cars_b, clock_a. Files in /tmp/claude-0/f79/audio/sfx, not in the repo.

relay.prompt: A single heavy electromechanical relay clicks in a dark kitchen: one short dry clack, a lamp hum dies away with the low hum of a refrigerator, then complete silence. Close, clean, very quiet, no music, no voices.

phones.prompt: Dozens of phones on a quiet street all chime with the same soft notification tone at the very same moment: a layered glassy ding from windows and pockets, then a gentle decaying shimmer. Calm, slightly eerie, no music, no voices.

cars.negative_prompt: music, voices, horn, engine roar, siren
cars.prompt: A few driverless electric cars glide slowly past on an empty tidy street: soft tyre hiss on asphalt, a faint electric whine, gentle passing whooshes, then quiet again. Even and loopable, no horns, no engine roar, no voices, no music.

clock.prompt: An old brass alarm clock is wound in a quiet room: slow ratcheting key turns and spring tension clicks, then it ticks steadily and a short soft bell rings gently. Warm, close, intimate, no music, no voices.
